query: Which material can be used for to improve the ductility and toughness of the HfZrTi high-entropy alloy (HEAs), and why?

generation.hypothesis: Addition of a ductile and tough material, such as Ni or Co, to the HfZrTi high-entropy alloy can improve its ductility and toughness.
generation.mechanism: Improved dislocation mobility and reduced brittleness
generation.boundary: Limited to the specific composition and processing conditions of the HfZrTi HEA
generation.uncertainty: The optimal amount of Ni or Co addition and the resulting microstructural changes are uncertain

falsification_experiment.design: Tensile testing and microstructural characterization of HfZrTi HEA with varying amounts of Ni or Co addition
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the addition of Ni or Co does not result in improved ductility and toughness, as measured by tensile testing and microstructural characterization, the hypothesis is falsified.
